nodes.name: African juniper
nodes.desc: Evergreen conifer that dominates the Daallo escarpment forest alongside wild olive. Its blue-black berry-like cones feed birds such as bulbuls and pigeons.

nodes.name: Wild olive
nodes.desc: An evergreen tree that grows with juniper on the rocky scarp and helps form the dry montane forest canopy.

nodes.name: Somali tree aloe
nodes.desc: A tall tree aloe, one of the most frequently recorded plants of the Erigavo highlands in GBIF data.

nodes.name: Red grass
nodes.desc: A tufted grass of highland clearings and open slopes, recorded in the Daallo area, providing seeds and leaves for small herbivores.

nodes.name: Bruce's yellow-spotted hyrax
nodes.desc: A rock-dwelling mammal that lives in colonies in rocky terrain. Hyraxes eat a wide variety of plants and are hunted by raptors, snakes and carnivores.

nodes.name: Salt's dik-dik
nodes.desc: A tiny antelope of bushland and thickets in the Horn of Africa. It feeds mainly on leaves and shoots of acacia and other shrubs.

nodes.name: Klipspringer
nodes.desc: A small antelope that lives on rocky cliffs and outcrops, browsing on leaves, shoots and fruit.

nodes.name: Rameron pigeon
nodes.desc: A fruit-eating forest pigeon. GloBI records it eating African juniper.

nodes.name: Common bulbul
nodes.desc: A very commonly recorded songbird around Daallo. GloBI records it eating African juniper.

nodes.name: Mediterranean katydid
nodes.desc: A leaf-eating insect recorded near Erigavo that feeds on plant foliage and is prey for insect-eating birds and lizards.

nodes.name: Warsangli linnet
nodes.desc: A finch found only in Somalia, in dry forest and high shrubland. It is Near Threatened because of habitat loss and is one of the species behind the Daallo bird area.

nodes.name: Wildcat
nodes.desc: A small cat that hunts hyraxes and small birds. GloBI holds records of it eating rock hyrax and wheatears.

nodes.name: Isabelline wheatear
nodes.desc: A migratory insect-eating bird that winters in open country and is a prey item of wildcats in GloBI records.

nodes.name: Eritrean ridgeback agama
nodes.desc: A rock-dwelling lizard that eats insects and is itself prey for snakes and raptors.

nodes.name: Arabian cobra
nodes.desc: A venomous snake that hunts lizards and other small animals among the rocks of the highlands.

nodes.name: African golden wolf
nodes.desc: An opportunistic canid recorded in the Daallo area that eats small mammals and other prey.

nodes.name: Augur buzzard
nodes.desc: A cliff-nesting bird of prey of African highlands, recorded in the Daallo area, that takes hyraxes, lizards and snakes.

nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.desc: Bright highland sun drives growth in the open forest and grassland.

nodes.name: Mist & seasonal rain
nodes.desc: The scarp catches moisture rising from the Gulf of Aden coast, and the two main rains (April to June and October to November) support the forest.

nodes.name: Limestone soil
nodes.desc: Thin soils on a limestone and gypsum escarpment hold the roots of juniper and olive.

nodes.name: Fungi, termites & bacteria
nodes.desc: Break down fallen leaves, wood and dead animals and return nutrients to the thin soil.
